name: @duck-desk/desktop
description: Mac desktop companion for Duck Desk live overlays.
author: Duck Desk

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @duck-desk/shared && npm run build -w @duck-desk/overlay && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main && npm run build:preload && electron .
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main && npm run build:preload
scripts.dist: npm run build -w @duck-desk/shared && npm run build -w @duck-desk/overlay && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --dir --arm64
scripts.dist:dmg: npm run build -w @duck-desk/shared && npm run build -w @duck-desk/overlay && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64
